startersHint: A starter sets the size limit and quality. You can change them under More options.
pick: 2. Add your video and choose the part to keep
pickHint: Pick a video from your phone or computer, up to {max} MB. It is not uploaded.
trimHint: Play the video, pause where you want it to begin and tap Start here. Do the same for the end. The new video will be {seconds} seconds long.
tooLong: Only {max} minutes from the start point are used. Move the start point to use a different part.
readingSound: Reading the sound of your video...
noSoundFound: The sound of this video could not be read, or it has none. The new video will have no sound.
fileFailed: This video could not be opened. Try an MP4 or MOV file, or open this page in Chrome.
tooBig: This file is bigger than {max} MB. Cut it into a shorter part with your phone's own editor first, then add it here.
limitHint: The tool picks the quality so the file fits under this size. A long video squeezed into a small size looks softer.
sizeHint: A smaller picture makes a much smaller file. A video is never made bigger than the original.
quality: Quality (when there is no size limit)
qualityHint: Medium looks good on a phone screen. High keeps more detail and makes a bigger file.
smoothHint: Fewer frames a second makes a smaller file, but fast movement looks less smooth. A video that has fewer frames than this keeps what it has.
keepSoundHint: Turn this off to make a silent video, which is a little smaller.
estimate: New video: about {size}, {w} by {h}, {fps} frames a second, {seconds} seconds.
tooSmall: This size limit is very small for this length, so the file may come out bigger than the limit. Try a shorter part, a smaller picture or a bigger limit.
alreadySmall: This video is already small. The new file may not be much smaller. You can still cut it.
silent: The new video will have no sound.
noMake: This browser cannot make a video file. Try a recent Chrome, Edge or Safari.
slowNote: This browser makes the video by playing it, so it takes as long as the video. Keep this page open. Chrome and Edge are faster.
keepOpenSmooth: Making the video: {done}% done, about {left} seconds left. Keep this screen on and stay on this page.
keepOpen: Keep this screen on and stay on this page while the video is made. It takes as long as the video.
failed: The video could not be made. Try a smaller picture size, a shorter part, or a recent Chrome.
notSmaller: {from} became {to}. The new file is not smaller, so keep your original instead.
smoothNote: Saved as an MP4 file with every frame drawn.
webmNote: This browser saves WebM video. It plays in Chrome, Edge and Firefox. If an app does not accept it, open this page in Chrome on a computer or a recent Android phone and save again.
notSaved: Your video is never uploaded. Only your size and quality choices are remembered on this device, not the video.
